messages:
Incident Bot: Paging oncall for alert 'routing.economy_funnel: quality_degradation' — significant uptick in customer-facing LLM quality regressions after routing policy change. Pager link: https://rbwd/alerts/4872 :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: on it. picking this up — Maya/onsite. can someone dump the routing decision logs for the last 30m?
Josh K: grabbing logs now. preliminary: lots of traffic marked as 'economy' and routed to variant 'gptx-eco-q4_8' which is 8-bit quantized. Latency/cost dropped but eval scores down ~18% on our prod prompt set.
Li Chen: where did that routing policy come from? I thought economy_funnel was disabled last week.
Emily R: product rolled a new policy yesterday to expand low-cost coverage for free-tier customers. it should have had a safety gate.
Josh K: paste logs snippet: ```
2025-09-22T03:08:12Z route_decision id=... user=acct-123 policy=economy_funnel matched_rule=tag:free_tier -> variant=gptx-eco-q4_8 score=0.92
2025-09-22T03:08:13Z ev_eval id=... promptset=prod_runtime avg_quality=0.62 baseline=0.75 delta=-0.13
```
Maya Patel: impact? any customer pages?
Support Bot: 12 external incidents opened (support tickets) referencing hallucinations/incorrect answers in the last 45m, top customers: retail-api, smartdocs. severity trending medium-high.
Li Chen: mitigation plan: 1) disable economy_funnel routing rule 2) re-route active sessions to fallback 'gptx-stable-v1' 3) roll forward a canary to control traffic. who can run the policy disable?
Josh K: I can push the disable now. running control-plane API: ```
curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane.internal/v1/routing/policies/economy_funnel" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
Maya Patel: do it. add a rollout tag so we can audit.
Josh K: done. response: 200 OK. policy.enabled=false. audit_id=ap-5544. Confirming new decisions: same API shows no matches for economy_funnel since 03:12:01Z.
Li Chen: re-route active sessions command (hot path) ```
POST /v1/routing/reassign
{
  "selector":"variant==gptx-eco-q4_8 AND age<60m",
  "target":"gptx-stable-v1",
  "mode":"graceful"
}
```
Josh K: reassign job submitted, tracker=https://rbwd/jobs/9812. progress: 78% reassign complete, 22% still draining (long-lived KV caches).
Maya Patel: good. Pager: notify support to escalate top 3 customers and send rollback note. Emily can you handle customer comms?
Emily R: yes. drafting message: "We've temporarily disabled a routing policy causing poorer model quality for some free-tier requests. We're rerouting traffic to a stable model and investigating. No billing changes."
Maya Patel: solid. also: collect sample prompts/responses for postmortem. Josh, can you stash a few pairs?
Josh K: grabbing sample pairs and eval diffs. saved to s3://rbwd-incident/2050019876/samples.tar.gz
Maya Patel: handoff to Li for monitoring and follow-up. Li, take over — I'll escalate if new customer P1s show up.
Li Chen: taking over. I'll keep a 15-min cadence. first checks: latency stable, error rates down 0.4%, quality delta improving back to baseline after reassign.
Support Bot: Support tickets flagged as 'root_cause:routing_policy' updated. assigned to @Emily R.
Emily R: sent initial customer notes to top 3, opened a public status update draft on status.redwood.ai.
Josh K: root cause notes: policy matcher used a new rule precedence that unintentionally allowed 'free_tier' to match both 'economy_funnel' and fallback; because precedence evaluation used lexicographic order, economy rule slid ahead of a quality-gate. config diff attached: ```
- rules:
-  - id: quality_gate
-    match: "tag:free_tier AND quality_score>0.7"
-  - id: economy_funnel
-    match: "tag:free_tier"
+ rules:
+  - id: economy_funnel
+    match: "tag:free_tier"
+  - id: quality_gate
+    match: "tag:free_tier AND quality_score>0.7"
```
Maya Patel: ugh, ordering bug. action items: add explicit priority field, add unit test for rule ordering, add canary that measures eval delta pre-deploy.
Li Chen: I'll add a temporary guard: if delta_quality <-0.10 for prod promptset, circuit-break economy_funnel automatically.
Emily R: postmortem owners? Maya (incident lead), Josh (root cause + runtime fix), Li (automation guard + monitoring), Emily (customer comms). ETA for full RCA: 48h.
Maya Patel: closing notes: we've restored customer-facing quality by 03:18Z, policy disabled, reroute completed. scheduling a follow-up warroom at 2025-09-23 16:00 UTC. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
